create_logbuffer_instance: create a LogBuffer instance to track training metrics with val_history and n_history OrderedDicts
update_logbuffer_metrics: update the LogBuffer with a dictionary of metric values and their counts for tracking
average_logbuffer_values: average the latest n values in the LogBuffer and store results in the output dictionary
clear_logbuffer_history: clear all val_history, n_history, and output data from the LogBuffer instance
clear_logbuffer_output: clear only the output dictionary and reset the ready flag to False on the LogBuffer
